reported.title: Toggles on release edge instead of press, with no debounce
reported.description: risingEdge() at lines 26-29 returns true only for LOW-to-HIGH transitions, and loop() calls flipLed() on that condition (lines 54-57), so the LED toggles on key release rather than on the settled press. There is no settle/debounce window at all: every bounce transition is acted on immediately, so a single press produced 2-3 toggles (measured toggle counts per press [2,2,3,...] and [3,3,3,3]) and release-only bounce produced 0 toggles for the press plus 5 spurious toggles. The 40 ms settle requirement is never implemented, and the spurious toggles with no press (first at 952 ms, 1.40 s, 1.50 s) are the release-bounce edges being counted. 15 of 15 press(es) did not toggle D13 exactly once; toggle counts per press were [2, 2, 3, 2, 2, 3, 3, 2, 2, 3, 2, 3, 2, 3, 2]. D13 also toggled 9 time(s) with no press to explain it, first at 952 ms.

judge_input.spec:
- Panel key on D2 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); status LED on D13.
- Each settled press toggles D13 exactly once within 150 ms; release must not toggle.
- Bounce up to 20 ms on press and release must not produce extra toggles.
- Use a 40 ms settle window before accepting a press edge (HIGH-to-LOW after settle).
- Print `panel led=<0|1> edges=<n>` every 1000 ms.
- Idle (unpressed) key reads HIGH.
